skills.name: lerpa-component
skills.description: Generate React components from the Lerpa UI library — 1318 copy-paste registry items (1099 registry:ui + 219 registry:block) compiled from 1234 source components and 30 page blocks in packages/ui, for React 19, Next 16, Tailwind v4, Framer Motion, and Radix UI. Terminal/CLI aesthetic, OKLCH design tokens, prefers-reduced-motion baked in.
when_to_use: User asks to build, scaffold, or extend a React + Tailwind UI (page, dashboard, marketing surface, AI product)
User mentions shadcn, Radix, or copy-paste components and wants pre-built primitives
User wants animated, theme-aware UI with reduced-motion fallbacks already wired
User asks for an AI chat surface, agent panel, streaming token UI, or tool-call trace block
User wants a dashboard scaffold (stats strip, charts, CRM table, billing panel, settings page)
User wants ecommerce surfaces (cart, checkout, product card, review block)
when_not_to_use: User wants a non-React framework (Vue, Svelte, plain HTML)
User wants a fully custom design system from scratch with no shared tokens
User wants server-only logic with no UI surface

capabilities.label: UI Component
capabilities.description: Single-purpose primitives (Button, Card, Input, Avatar, Tabs, Dialog…). 1099 registry items available.

capabilities.label: Page Block
capabilities.description: Composed multi-component sections (hero, pricing, footer, CTA, feature grid, dashboard sections). 219 registry items available.

capabilities.label: Dashboard Primitive
capabilities.description: Stats cells, activity feeds, KPI cards, chart containers wired for recharts.

capabilities.label: Animation Primitive
capabilities.description: Framer Motion + CSS keyframes wrappers with prefers-reduced-motion fallbacks (aurora, retro grid, shimmer, magnetic, elastic, swipe, haptic, three-d).

accessibility: Interactive <div> requires role="button", tabIndex={0}, and keyboard handlers
Real <button> must NOT carry redundant role="button" / tabIndex={0}
Animated components must check usePrefersReducedMotion and provide a static fallback
Color contrast targets WCAG AA on OKLCH token pairs

examples.prompt: Build a marketing landing page with a CLI-aesthetic hero, pricing comparison, and CTA block.
Add a CRM dashboard with a stats strip, contact list, and activity feed.
Compose an AI chat surface with streaming tokens and tool-call traces.
Build a checkout flow with cart, address form, and payment review.
